definitions.short: Joktheel , the name of a place in Palestine, and of one in Idumaea
definitions.full: H3371. Yoqtheel יָקְתְאֵל proper name, of a location (according to Ol § 277 k. 3 יקת is Imperfect from a √ קות , meaning dubious; possibly = יְקוּתִיאֵל q. v.; see Wetzst in De Isa 3:703 f. ) — 1 in the Shephelah of Judah Josh 15:38 , site unknown; ᵐ5 Ιακαρεηλ A Ιεκθαηλ , ᵐ5 L Ιεχθαηλ . 2 name given to סֶלַע (= Petra) by King Amaziah, its captor 2Kin 14:7 ; ᵐ5 Καθοηλ ; A Ιεκθοηλ .
